ai_seo_ai_seo.question: What is AI SEO?
ai_seo_ai_seo.answer: AI SEO is optimisation for AI-powered answer engines. It makes your content retrievable, quotable and attributable so assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews name your brand when answering relevant questions.

ai_seo_ai_seo_different.question: Is AI SEO different from traditional SEO?
ai_seo_ai_seo_different.answer: It overlaps but is not identical. Traditional SEO competes for ranked links; AI SEO competes for inclusion inside a synthesised answer. Content format, entity consistency and structured data matter more, and success is measured in citations rather than positions.

ai_seo_ai_seo_replace.question: Does AI SEO replace normal SEO?
ai_seo_ai_seo_replace.answer: No. Most assistants retrieve from live search results, so poor crawlability or weak authority still blocks you. AI SEO is a layer on top of technically sound, authoritative SEO.

ai_seo_measure_ai_visibility.question: How do you measure AI visibility?
ai_seo_measure_ai_visibility.answer: We maintain a prompt set of real buyer questions and run it monthly across the major assistants, recording whether your brand is mentioned, cited with a link, described accurately, and how that compares to competitors.

ai_seo_long_ai_seo.question: How long does AI SEO take to show results?
ai_seo_long_ai_seo.answer: Retrieval improvements from structured data and content reformatting can appear within 2–6 weeks. Entity and authority work — the part that makes models recommend you unprompted — typically takes three to six months.

ai_seo_control_ai_says.question: Can you control what an AI says about my brand?
ai_seo_control_ai_says.answer: You cannot control it directly, but you can strongly influence it by publishing clear, consistent, well-structured facts about your business and getting those facts repeated on sources the models trust.

ai_seo_should_i_block.question: Should I block AI crawlers?
ai_seo_should_i_block.answer: If you want AI visibility, no. Blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended removes you from those systems. We configure robots.txt deliberately so you allow the engines you want to appear in.

ai_seo_llmstxt.question: What is llms.txt?
ai_seo_llmstxt.answer: llms.txt is a plain-text file at the root of a site that summarises what the site offers and links to key pages in a machine-friendly way. It is an emerging convention we implement as part of LLMO work.

ai_seo_ai_seo_work.question: Does AI SEO work for local businesses?
ai_seo_ai_seo_work.answer: Yes. Prompts like 'best dentist near Dondaparthy' are answered from directories, reviews and structured data, so clean NAP, LocalBusiness schema and review content directly affect whether you are recommended.

ai_seo_much_ai_seo.question: How much does AI SEO cost?
ai_seo_much_ai_seo.answer: AI SEO packages are priced alongside our SEO retainers and start from a baseline audit; most clients run AI SEO as an add-on layer to an existing SEO programme. See our AI SEO packages page for current tiers.
